hook_line: INDIA GOLD DEMAND SEEN AT SIX-YEAR LOW

hook_stat.sub: World Gold Council estimate for India's 2026 demand, the lowest since 2020

stats.label: India's gold demand in the September quarter, down 29% year-on-year
Fall in jewellery purchases in the September quarter
Fall in investment demand in the September quarter

diaspora_bullets: More than half of India's gold demand comes from rural areas, where jewellery is a traditional store of wealth
Demand is likely to improve in the December quarter as Diwali and the wedding season drive purchases
news_summary: The World Gold Council estimates India's gold demand in 2026 will fall to around 650 metric tons, the lowest since 2020, as elevated prices weigh on jewellery and investment demand.
payoff: Elevated prices, rising living costs and a weak monsoon are weighing on India's gold demand.
